semantic_redundancy_groups.reason: Both describe elongation of low-signal objects; mean eccentricity was retained for clearer image-level interpretation.
Both describe low-signal occupancy; LowSignalRatio is the canonical direct area-fraction descriptor.

malignant_vs_non_malignant.reason: At the fourth-feature boundary, solidity added a nonredundant low-signal morphology dimension to the already selected texture, distribution-shape, and elongation descriptors.

inflammatory_vs_hyperplastic.reason: At the fourth-feature boundary, low-signal area fraction added canonical signal-occupancy information to the already selected intensity-distribution and morphology descriptors.

adenoma_vs_non_neoplastic.reason: Both descriptors were retained; the ordering records the original panel composition.

selection_rule: Rank the 31 nonredundant case-level descriptors by orientation-independent single-feature AUC.
Process candidates from the highest AUC downward.
Do not retain algebraically identical/complementary or semantically overlapping descriptors together.
Within a redundant group, retain the descriptor with higher AUC; when equal, use the documented preferred descriptor.
At an equal-AUC panel boundary, apply the documented task-specific priority based on interpretability and complementary image information.
Stop after four nonredundant descriptors have been retained.
validation_scope_note: Ranking and panel construction use the complete current cohort and are not nested within LOOCV; resulting AUCs are exploratory same-cohort internal-validation estimates.
